title: Who buys Hawaii luxury ($3M+) and ultra ($10M+) homes: counts by island, type and half-year, buyer origin, cash, notable 2025-2026 sales
updated: 2026-10-08 (re-run: tabulations re-verified against luxury_report_counts.csv, 0 mismatches; web refresh for Q3 2026 releases)

source.luxury_counts: dl/appl2/luxury_report_counts.csv (Hawaii Life Luxury Market Reports: 2022 Year-End, 2025 Q4 YTD, 2026 Midyear; List Sotheby's International Realty Oahu Quarterly Luxury Market Reports 2022Q3-2026Q2). Company-reported MLS-based counts.
source.hawaii_life_report_text: pull/mm_luxury/hl_lux_2026mid.txt, hl_lux_2025ye.txt, hl_lux_2025mid.txt (text of the Hawaii Life PDFs already on disk) for qualitative buyer statements and highest sales.
source.maui_schedule_split: dl/appl2/maui_sales_history_fy2016_2026.csv (Maui County RPT sales file, conveyance tax matched to HRS 247-2 schedule; see dl/appl2/maui_sales_extract.py.txt).
source.hmda: an/who/hmda_tiers.json (HMDA 2025 Snapshot, first-lien originated purchase loans, 1-4 unit site-built).
source.dbedt_tg: an/new/databook.json (DBEDT State Data Book 2025 Tables 21.36-21.38, Title Guaranty data) and an/new/tg.json (Title Guaranty Buyer Statistics Q4 2025 and Q2 2026 editions).
source.uhero: an/new/uhero.json (UHERO Hawaii Housing Factbook 2026, released 2026-05-07; 2025 deeds).
source.web: Searches and page downloads 2026-10-08; raw pages in raw/who_luxury_buyers/ (Caron B Realty, List Sotheby's, KHON2, Coldwell Banker, Hoodline, Scotsman Guide, Aloha State Daily, Ward Village PR, Coldwell Banker Island Properties blog).

method: A. Hawaii Life 2026 Midyear chart rows (basis=chart): $10M+ sold counts by island (county) x {house, condo} x half-year 2022H2-2026H1, tabulated as read; statewide = sum of the 4 counties. Cross-checked against the reports' text rows.

B. Hawaii Life text rows: $3M+ sold counts by island x {house, condo, land} and by band {$3-6M, $6-10M, $10M+} for 2022 (full year), 2025 (full year) and 2026H1. Type totals equal band totals in every island-period (asserted).

C. List Sotheby's Oahu quarterly counts summed into half-years (H1=Q1+Q2, H2=Q3+Q4); a half with a missing quarter is flagged complete=false with the missing quarter named. Bands are List SIR's ($2-3M, $3-5M, $5-10M, $10M+ houses; $1-2.5M, $2.5M+, $5M+ condos).

D. Maui County: recorded sales FY2016-FY2026 (July-June), 5+ unit building sales excluded; 'owner' = HRS 247-2 schedule (1) on improved residential parcels, 'nonowner' = schedule (2) = condo/single-family sale to a buyer NOT eligible for the county homeowner exemption; share = nonowner/(owner+nonowner); 'nonres' (vacant land, non-residential, unmatched) excluded. Bins align with the $1.5M, $3M and $10M tier edges.

E. Financing: HMDA 2025 first-lien purchase loans with property_value >= $3M (tiers luxury+ultra from hmda_tiers.json) divided by Hawaii Life 2025 $3M+ house+condo sold counts by county; 1 - ratio = implied share of $3M+ home purchases without a HMDA-reported purchase mortgage (a cash-share proxy, not a measured cash share).

F. Buyer-origin price tilt: DBEDT Data Book 2025 county averages by buyer origin (Title Guaranty classification) and Title Guaranty top states/countries with dollars; avg = published dollars / count (dollars published rounded, so approx).
G. UHERO 2026 Factbook out-of-state deed shares (2025) for resort / high-price ZIPs, all price levels.
H. Sibling owner-roll joins quoted by reference (not recomputed).

I. Web: WebSearch + page download (curl) of primary pages where reachable; each figure carries URL, publication/sale date, whether company-reported, and how it was verified (page text vs search snippet only).
notes: All Hawaii Life and List Sotheby's counts are company-reported MLS counts (not recorded deeds); Hawaii Life 'luxury' = $3M+, 'ultra' = $10M+; List SIR uses its own bands ($2-3M/$3-5M/$5-10M/$10M+ houses; $1-2.5M/$2.5M+/$5M+ condos), so its bands do not align with the report's tier edges except at $3M and $10M.

Half-year granularity exists only for (a) Hawaii Life $10M+ house/condo by island 2022H2-2026H1 (chart read) and (b) List SIR Oahu quarterly bands summed to halves. $3M+ by island x type x band is available only for 2022, 2025 (full years) and 2026H1.

Every island-half $10M+ cell is n<20; statewide $10M+ halves range 13-30 sales. List SIR halves with a missing quarter are flagged complete=false (2024H1/2024H2 condo $5M+, 2026H1 several bands missing Q1 2026).

Hawaii Island $10M+ house chart read (2025H1 15, 2025H2 8; sum 23) conflicts with the 2025 year-end text (17); a text-consistent alternative (10/7) is given. Oahu 2025 chart house+condo (10) exceeds the report's all-type $10M+ text (9). Treat chart values as +/-1-2 per cell.

Buyer ORIGIN by price band is not published by any source found for 2025-2026: Hawaii Life gives qualitative statements only; Title Guaranty and DBEDT give origin for all sales; Caron B gives Oahu-only shares for its own 'luxury' segment (lowest band $1.8M, threshold not stated) in small quarterly samples.

Quantitative origin for $3M+ in this file comes from (i) Maui County conveyance-tax schedule (nonowner = buyer not eligible for homeowner exemption; includes Hawaii residents buying second homes/investments, so it is an UPPER bound on out-of-state share) and (ii) sibling owner-roll joins (current mailing address of buyers still holding; quoted by reference).

Cash share for $3M+ is NOT published for Hawaii; the HMDA-loans / MLS-sales ratio is a proxy (implied share without a HMDA-reported purchase mortgage), which overstates cash because some lenders (non-HMDA reporters, portfolio/private banks, foreign lenders) are missing and HMDA property_value is binned/appraised, not price.
Notable sales: buyer origin was not publicly reported for any 2025-2026 top sale found; no names are recorded here. Aggregates only: no owner names, street addresses or parcel ids.
Web figures carry URL, publication date, company_reported flag and verification level (page_text vs search_snippet_only); snippet-only figures are unverified.

Qualitative only: O'ahu 'is the one island with a deep, continuous, local buyer base'; above $10M on O'ahu 'a buyer pool that turns discretionary and global'; Maui: 'local buyers are stepping selectively into the $3 million tier where they see dislocation, behavior this segment rarely shows'; luxury days on market 86-151 because 'Buyers at this tier arrive from elsewhere, on their own travel schedules'. No buyer-origin percentages are published in the report.

cash.figure: Hawaii all-cash share 44.9% of home sales, 4th highest state (Mississippi 49.6%, Montana 46%, Idaho 45%, Hawaii 44.9%, Maine 44.4%); report attributes Hawaii's level to 'affluent second-home buyers, many of them equity-rich and older'. Nationally >40% of homes priced above $1M and >50% above $2M were bought with cash.
